sources.information: The official Sziget homepage identifies the festival, announces its 10–14 August 2027 return, and lists 5-day, 21&Under, and VIP pass prices. It also describes 2026 as a festival that has ended.

The official FAQ confirms 2027 dates of 10–14 August and says performers will be announced later. It references the 2026 festival, but does not establish its exact programme dates or a full ticket price list.
The official travel page says Sziget takes place on Óbuda Island and gives the official address as Május 9. park, Budapest, Hungary, 1033.
The official ticket page was inspected, but its ticket catalogue did not render in the available read; the homepage supplies some 2027 pass prices, not a complete list.

sourceSummaries.information: The official Sziget homepage identifies the festival, announces its 10–14 August 2027 return, and lists 5-day, 21&Under, and VIP pass prices. It also describes 2026 as a festival that has ended.

The official FAQ confirms 2027 dates of 10–14 August and says performers will be announced later. It references the 2026 festival, but does not establish its exact programme dates or a full ticket price list.
The official travel page says Sziget takes place on Óbuda Island and gives the official address as Május 9. park, Budapest, Hungary, 1033.
The official ticket page was inspected, but its ticket catalogue did not render in the available read; the homepage supplies some 2027 pass prices, not a complete list.
